class.name: MobaMapPreview3D
class.description: At runtime, creates a capsule hero, following orthographic camera, light and status overlay. Left-click terrain to move and use the mouse wheel to zoom. Waits for map navigation before spawning. Contains no MOBA game rules. The editor Play map command creates a separate scene with this node and a snapshot of the map.

members.member: Path to the map to preview.
